project.name: Academic Chatbot DevOps & AI Platform
project.description: Agile lifecycle, DevOps automation, and production monitoring for the Academic Chatbot RAG system.

sprints.name: Sprint 1: Core Grounded RAG & Semantic Retrieval
sprints.goal: Build robust TF-IDF retrieval, multi-format PDF parsing, and strict grounded refusal system.

sprints.name: Sprint 2: UI/UX Redesign & Academic Formula Rendering
sprints.goal: Implement editorial light theme, multi-line LaTeX equations, and document telemetry.

sprints.name: Sprint 3: Dockerization, Multi-Service Compose & Jenkins CI/CD
sprints.goal: Multi-stage Dockerfile, docker-compose orchestration, Jenkins pipeline, and GitHub Actions.

sprints.name: Sprint 4: Observability, Prometheus, Grafana & Nagios Monitoring
sprints.goal: Instrumentation with Prometheus metrics exporter, Grafana dashboards, and Nagios health plugins.

issues.summary: Implement Multi-Stage Dockerfile with Non-Root Security User
issues.description: Create an optimized multi-stage Python 3.11-slim Dockerfile separating wheel compilation from the runtime image and executing as non-root user appuser (UID 1000).

issues.summary: Orchestrate Multi-Service Architecture with Docker Compose
issues.description: Assemble docker-compose.yml linking academic-chatbot, Prometheus, Grafana, and cAdvisor with persistent storage and custom bridge network.

issues.summary: Configure Containerized Jenkins LTS Pipeline with Declarative Jenkinsfile
issues.description: Develop 7-stage declarative Jenkinsfile covering checkout, static analysis, unit testing, docker build, security audit, deployment, and Nagios verification.

issues.summary: Automate GitHub Actions Continuous Integration and Deployment Pipeline
issues.description: Establish .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml and pr-verify.yml to execute automated linting, test suites, docker builds, and compose healthchecks on push and PR.

issues.summary: Instrument Python Application with Prometheus Metrics Exporter
issues.description: Add prometheus_client metrics to record throughput, query latency histograms, grounded refusal counters, and active document gauges on port 8000.

issues.summary: Design Production Grafana Dashboard with Real-Time SRE Telemetry
issues.description: Construct automated Grafana provisioning with Prometheus data source and rich JSON dashboard visualizing latency percentiles (P95/P50) and refusal rates.

issues.summary: Develop Nagios Core Monitoring Plugin and Service Definitions
issues.description: Write check_chatbot_health.py complying with Nagios plugin API (exit codes 0/1/2/3 and perfdata output) and chatbot_service.cfg configuration.

issues.summary: Enforce Jira Smart Commit Git Hooks and Branching Conventions
issues.description: Implement .githooks/commit-msg and pre-commit hooks validating issue ticket format and automated Conventional Commit tagging.
